Maya (marketing): heads-up: planning announce for Optimize v2 next Wed 09:00 PT. need final changelog link + docs quickstart + confirmed rollout window. can eng confirm?
Dev (eng): propose canary 05:30 PT, 10% at 06:30, 50% at 07:45, full at 09:15 if healthy. marketing prefer public blog at 09:00?
Maya (marketing): yes blog at 09:00. well hold large mailers until 09:20 to avoid early traffic spikes.
Liam (docs): docs PR opened: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/499 — changelog draft and quickstart in the head. will merge once eng adds the final migration note.
Sana (devex): webinar set for 10:00 PT, landing page draft ready. need 2-3 benchmark bullets and one-line plain english summary for hero.
Dev (eng): bullets: "~2x faster on long-context chats", "~20% lower per-token cost", "<120ms 95th pct tail on 32k tests". plain english: "Optimize v2 speeds up long conversations while cutting inference cost."
Maya (marketing): good. please post the merged changelog URL here after merge so we can link it in the blog. also ask eng to monitor warm pools and avoid promos until 09:20.
DeployBot: deploy window reserved: staging canary @ 2026-04-08T05:30:00Z, prod start @ 2026-04-08T09:00:00Z. rollback threshold: 10% 5xx over 5m.
Dev (eng): noted. will post status updates during rollout and the merged changelog link.
Liam (docs): merged — changelog: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2; quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/optimize-v2. added migration note for cache config.
Maya (marketing): perfect. final day-of checklist: eng monitor canary + paste merge link (you), docs verify redirects (you), devex update webinar CTA (you), marketing publish blog + social at 09:00 and delay mailers until 09:20 (me). any blockers?
Dev (eng): none.
Maya (marketing): thanks team — ill post the runbook here tomorrow morning. :rocket:
